verdicts.note: First-term incumbent with 20 years in the office who runs on his term's crime figures and staying under budget [S1][S2][S4][S7]. Nothing in the dossier points toward renewal.

'Proven to be tough on crime', 'aggressively investigate crimes and arrest' [S1], Drug Task Force funding [S2][S4]. The only pole-b element is rehabilitation services inside a new jail [S4]. -2 would be arguable, but the 'proactive efforts' and partnership framing [S2][S4] make -1 a safe call.

The 0 reflects real mixed evidence, not missing evidence. Wallace makes a roughly $50M capital jail project his #1 priority (pole b) [S1][S4], and in the same interview he calls the budget 'very constrained', says he stayed under budget every year and pitches modular units to halve the cost (pole a) [S4]. Most of the restraint evidence comes from one source (the Daily World Q&A, S4), so medium is the ceiling.

The direction holds against a sitting sheriff: Welter is the challenger and has never held county office. High overstates it, though. He is a 12-year officer who has worked inside this sheriff's office since 2018 [S1][S3][S6]. He is also a sitting elected official (Westport mayor 2024-2027, and briefly a hospital district commissioner) [S2][S10], and he runs partly on his mayoral record [S2][S6][S11]. The 'a new perspective' quote in the scoring basis and the contest overview has no cited position line in his dossier. His renewal case is about who leads the office, not an outsider profile.

Enforce all laws and investigate property crime 'to their fullest' [S4], proactive drug enforcement and nuisance enforcement, and support for ALPR data protections [S6]. 'Accountability does not always mean prison' and therapeutic courts [S6] keep him from -2.

Adding deputies is an explicit, repeated plank with figures (35 deputies to 34 since 2000, 1.5 to 1 per 1,000 residents, against a national 2.5) [S4][S8], and he would seek state funding [S1]. That supports +1. His hedges ('the current state of the county budget needs to be considered', 'fiscally responsible ways') [S4][S8] rule out +2. S4 and S8 largely repeat the same campaign text, so medium is as high as this should go.
